title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
creator: Michel Gondry
summary: A man has his memories of a relationship erased. The erasure happens in reverse. You watch him fall back in love with what's being taken away.
personalNote: The only film I know that makes grief feel like a form of love. The structure is one of cinema's great ideas — watching the erasure happen backwards, watching Joel fall back in love with the memory as it disappears. Carrey's quietest, best performance. The ending asks the only question that matters.
